note: Dalaran Heist boss decks (merged from sources/boss-decks-part*.json: hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages' Decks sections, cited per boss). kind fixed = the list with counts; pool = 'Possible cards' (no counts): a deck of the level's size is drawn from it each game. sizes = deck size per the boss's levels, low to high (wiki 'Total cards'). lowerLevelMissing = cards a fixed deck lacks at the boss's lower level (wiki: 'missing 5 random cards'). heroic null = the Normal deck. Cards the live recordings show a boss playing that the wiki lacks were added (notes say which).
